name: ovos/php-library
description: A batteries-included MVC framework and infrastructure toolkit for modern PHP: a cache that never stampedes (MemoLock), lazy RedisJSON sessions, filesystem routing, relations as attributes with zero N+1, a live profiler and a self-wiring DI container.

suggest.ext-yaml: YAML is required if you plan to use the Application class.
suggest.ext-apcu: APCu is required if you plan to use the Application class.
suggest.ext-redis: YAML is required if you plan to use the Application class.
suggest.ext-simplexml: SimpleXML is required if you plan to load XML files.
